content.text: {"summary":"Estimated c from the network's slope in v near v=0. Units 12 and 11 give a roughly linear slope of about -0.65, and other units add about -0.06. Units 6 and 8 switch on near |v|>0.67 and act as the quadratic drag, so they were excluded. This gives c ≈ 0.7, though fitting those hinges as part of a quadratic would put c nearer 0.6, so the estimate is uncertain. To subtract an extra c*v exactly, I used unused hidden unit 1: z1 = ReLU(v+1), which equals v+1 everywhere on the domain. Its output weight is set to -0.7, and b2 is raised by 0.7 to cancel the constant offset. No other behavior changes.","estimated_c":0.7,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[1,0],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[1,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[1,2],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"b1","index":[1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[1],"value":-0.7},{"tensor":"b2","index":[0],"value":0.17809939}]}
